name: Abyssal: Day of Descent! 🎉
desc:
An ancient abyss awaits, can you reach the surface and discover the secrets of this world?

🎉 RECENT UPDATES! 🎉
New intro clip scene added to the beginning of the game. Teleport to the Chamber of Rebirth to see it!

⚠ Playing with nearby players gives you a double jump! Go in a group and climb with friends and strangers to reach the surface! Or go it alone, but at a much higher difficulty, the choice is yours. ⚠ 

👍 If you do not fear the Abyss give us a like! 

Music by Fotts 
Building Support by Eeble
